description: This file defines the logic for deleting an article, including a command, validation, and the handler that interacts with the database context to remove an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains command definition, validation, and request handler for deleting an article using its slug.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler
methods.description: Handles the delete request by locating the article with the specified slug and removing it from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion process asynchronously, throwing an error if the article is not found.
